question: Which part of India did the Nizams of Asafjahi dynasty rule?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Deccan provinces**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Asafjahi dynasty**__

 
 
• The **Asaf Jahi** was a **Muslim dynasty**.
 
• It ruled the **kingdom of Hyderabad.**
 
• They came to India in the late **17th century and became employees of the Mughal Empire.**
 
• Asaf Jahi rules over **Golconda with the capital at Aurangabad.**
 
• **Founded by**: Mir Qamar-ud-Din Siddiqi, a Viceroy of the Deccan emperors from 1713 to 1721.
 
• **Last Ruler** : Mir Osman Ali Khan
